findings.highlight: if you die trying to save me
findings.evidenceJa: 助けてもらった相手に死なれたら
findings.governingReading: if the person who saved Rin then dies
findings.explanation: Rin’s objection concerns being unable to repay a rescuer who dies afterward; the English makes death part of the rescue attempt itself.

findings.highlight: It vanished when you stepped onto the shadow and fainted.
findings.evidenceJa: 影の上に立って、倒れたと思ったらもういなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou stood on the shadow, and by the time Rin thought he had fallen, it was already gone
findings.explanation: A sequential observation becomes simultaneous disappearance at the moment he steps on the shadow.

findings.governingReading: Rin thought Shirou had fallen or collapsed
findings.explanation: An observed fall is promoted into a diagnosed loss of consciousness.

findings.governingReading: for what felt like a very long time
findings.explanation: The scale of Shirou’s subjective duration is weakened before Rin reveals that fewer than ten seconds passed.

findings.highlight: I shall treat you as an enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 敵対行為とみなします
findings.governingReading: Saber will regard further approach as a hostile act
findings.explanation: A warning about one action is escalated into declaring Rin an enemy as a person.

findings.highlight: the nausea and the chill that tries to get me unconscious
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気と悪寒で途絶えそうになる意識
findings.governingReading: consciousness threatening to cut out under nausea and chills
findings.explanation: Symptoms are made singular agents that “try to get” Shirou unconscious in malformed English.

findings.highlight: the most that it can do
findings.governingReading: if the thing has material embodiment
findings.explanation: Archer’s ontological condition on his assessment disappears.

findings.highlight: draining the life from the townspeople
findings.evidenceJa: 町の人間から魔力を吸い上げている
findings.governingReading: draining Magical Energy from the townspeople
findings.explanation: The setting’s specific resource is replaced by literal life.

findings.highlight: because someone told me this is like a disease
findings.evidenceJa: 瘧のようだ、と誰かが言ったせいか
findings.governingReading: perhaps because someone said it was like ague
findings.explanation: The exact fever image prompting Shirou’s hallucinated bodily sensation is generalized.
The vector and its relation to fever are completely changed into maggots described by an unnatural adjective.

findings.governingReading: arise or breed inside his body
findings.explanation: The hallucinated internal generation mechanism disappears.

findings.highlight: tonight you’ve brought him home injured
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜は怪我をして帰ってきたんです
findings.explanation: Shirou’s state on return is reassigned to Saber as the agent who brings him back, sharpening Sakura’s blame beyond the wording.

findings.evidenceJa: それが出来ないっていうならせめて
findings.governingReading: if you cannot do that, then at least

findings.evidenceJa: ごめんなさい、と謝ったのか
findings.governingReading: or did the speaker apologize with “I’m sorry”?
findings.explanation: The second alternative is likewise rendered as an ungrammatical comma splice.
